items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: They asked me, George said, I said, sure, I play with George.

ctx.x: All I can know is the West Coast. And he know the band already going to have a booking to go out there. But some fellas, you see, they get head swollen like that and they say they're not used to experience traveling. And when this, Earl Hans, that was a man who had what you call original. He was, we know he come from big bands out of Chicago. You would call them swing bands, you understand? That, I know that. Seen him and I heard him. And they form a band, a Dixieland group in San Francisco. And when they sent…
How come that Joe got back into the band and you left?

items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: And I made that trip that time with George to California, remember? Oh yeah. That was in 56.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Bunk? I guess not the old days.

Not the old days. I played with Bunk, yeah. And after he, George and I came back from New York. That was another thing I forgot right after the wall, I was playing with that outfit, you know, different spot jobs, yeah, with Bunk and George and them. And I made that trip that time with George to California, remember? Oh yeah. That was in 56. George went replacing Joe Boston, the drummer. Well I played up there with them and came on back.
Did you ever enjoy joining Earl Hines?
